sentences.zh: 我觉得这更多是来自泰德的美术设计视角，而不是编剧方面。

sentences.en: If you have questions, just check us on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，可以在Instagram上联系我们。

sentences.en: It's a great way to send in your questions as well as through the website, as Josh had mentioned.
sentences.zh: 这也是发送你的问题的一个好途径，就像乔希之前提到的，还可以通过网站。

sentences.en: And another great thing to send in through the website are these letters that we read.
sentences.zh: 通过网站发送的另一个好东西就是我们读的这些信件。

sentences.en: And we have a lovely one today, Josh.
sentences.zh: 我们今天有一封很棒的信，乔希。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So this one is from Sarah.
sentences.zh: 所以这封信来自莎拉。

sentences.en: Hi, guys.
sentences.zh: 嗨，大家好。

sentences.en: I'm one of those millennials now in my 30s who saw this on TV when I was really young.
sentences.zh: 我是那种现在30多岁的千禧一代，我很小的时候就在电视上看过这个。

sentences.en: Then during uni, watched it as it blew up with my friends.
sentences.zh: 然后在大学期间，看着它和朋友们一起火爆起来。

sentences.en: My partner at the time spoke so highly of this show because, in his words, it was realistic.
sentences.zh: 我当时的伴侣对这部剧评价很高，因为用他的话来说，它很现实。

sentences.en: As in, so great to see a show where people hung out at bars and not coffee places, lived in tiny flats, and struggled with life rather than pretending to struggle.
sentences.zh: 就像，看到一部剧里的人是在酒吧而不是咖啡馆闲逛，住在狭小的公寓里，与生活抗争而不是假装在抗争，这真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Years on, I remain perpetually single, and I watch Him-Yim every year.
sentences.zh: 多年过去了，我依然一直是单身，而且我每年都会看《老爸老妈浪漫史》。

sentences.en: Not intentionally, it's just comfort food for me.
sentences.zh: 不是故意的，它对我来说只是一种精神慰藉。

sentences.en: For some reason, I always start with the Christmas episode where Lily is a Grinch.
sentences.zh: 不知为什么，我总是从莉莉当格林奇那一集圣诞节开始看。

sentences.en: Every time I watch for fun, every time I get drawn in, and every time I bawl my eyes out nearly every episode of the last season because the romantic in me,
sentences.zh: 每次我为了好玩看的时候，每次我都会被吸引进去，而且最后一季几乎每一集我都会哭得稀里哗啦，因为我心中的那个浪漫主义者——

sentences.en: who at this point is very cynical about life, still has a glimmer of hope that whoever it is I'm supposed to meet is just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 他此时对生活非常愤世嫉俗，但内心深处仍然有一丝微弱的希望，觉得无论我要遇见的那个人是谁，他就在拐角处。

sentences.en: I am very much a Ted.
sentences.zh: 我非常像泰德。

sentences.en: Like a lot of people are saying, HSP, highly sensitive person, hard on sleeve.
sentences.zh: 就像很多人说的那样，HSP，高度敏感的人，情感外露。

sentences.en: And at this point in my life, I super relate to the single fatigue Ted has towards the end of the show.
sentences.zh: 而在我人生的这个阶段，我对泰德在剧集快结束时表现出的单身疲劳感超级有共鸣。

sentences.en: That'd be a good episode title, single fatigue.
sentences.zh: 那会是一个很好的剧集标题，单身疲劳。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: But enough of that misery.
sentences.zh: 但那些悲伤就说到这里吧。

sentences.en: Genuinely, I always end up bawling not out of sadness, but hope.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我最后总是哭得稀里哗啦，不是因为悲伤，而是因为希望。

sentences.en: And also just gratefulness that I am who I am, and that I can feel this way and therefore experience life to its very fulleSt.
sentences.zh: 还有感激我是现在的我，我能有这种感受，因此能最完整地体验生活。

sentences.en: I really get a lot of lessons out of the show every time I watch,
sentences.zh: 我每次看这部剧都能学到很多东西，

sentences.en: and I'm really grateful for the reminder that there's always an older me who will see things differently in retrospect.
sentences.zh: 我也非常感谢它提醒我：总有一个年长的我在事后回过头来看待事物时会有不同的视角。

sentences.en: When I'm feeling particularly blue about my bad luck and love, I often think about how there's some plunker out there who hasn't met anyone like me yet,
sentences.zh: 当我因为自己在爱情上的坏运气而感到格外沮丧时，我经常会想，外面一定有什么傻瓜还没有遇到过像我这样的人，

sentences.en: and I've not met anyone like them yet, and that makes me go giddy in the moment.
sentences.zh: 而我也还没遇到过像他们那样的人，这让我在那一刻感到一阵眩晕。

sentences.en: How are we spelling?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么拼写？

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 不好意思。

sentences.en: How are we spelling plunker?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么拼写“傻瓜”（plunker）？

sentences.en: Can we talk about that?
sentences.zh: 我们能谈谈这个吗？

sentences.en: P-L-O-N-K-E-R.
sentences.zh: P-L-O-N-K-E-R。

sentences.en: I love this word so much, plunker.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢这个词了，plunker。

sentences.en: And that's her dream.
sentences.zh: 那是她的梦想。

sentences.en: I want to meet a plunker.
sentences.zh: 我想认识一个plunker。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Some plunker out there who hasn't met anyone like me yet, and I've never met anyone like them yet, and that makes me go giddy in the moment.
sentences.zh: 外面某个还没遇到过像我这样的人的傻瓜，我也还没遇到过像他们那样的人，这让我在那一刻感到一阵眩晕。

sentences.en: Thank you entirely for this.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你写信来。

sentences.en: With love, Sarah.
sentences.zh: 爱你的，莎拉。

sentences.en: Sarah.
sentences.zh: 莎拉。

sentences.en: Sarah, may you meet your plunker.
sentences.zh: 莎拉，愿你遇到你的挚爱。

sentences.en: How I met my plunker.
sentences.zh: 我是如何遇到我的挚爱的。

sentences.en: In just the right time.
sentences.zh: 在恰当的时间里。

sentences.en: I also, we've talked about this, but when I hear from women who relate to Ted so much, I always find it.
sentences.zh: 我也是，我们讨论过这个，但每当我听说有女性对泰德产生强烈的共鸣时，我总是觉得……

sentences.en: It comes up a lot, right?
sentences.zh: 这种情况经常出现，对吧？

sentences.en: I was thinking the exact same thing.
sentences.zh: 我刚才想的完全一样。

sentences.en: We hear that a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们经常听到这种说法。

sentences.en: I think that's great.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, Sarah, thanks for that lovely letter.
sentences.zh: 好的，莎拉，谢谢你寄来这封动人的信。

sentences.en: We're wishing you all the best, and we're glad we can accompany you through this strange journey called life.
sentences.zh: 我们祝你一切都好，也很高兴能陪伴你度过人生中这段奇妙的旅程。

sentences.en: I love that the show has made it around the world in the way it has, and we're hearing we started this episode with learning English, and we ended the episode in England, I think.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴这部剧能以这种方式火遍全球，我们听说——这集开头我们学了英语，而这集结尾我们在英国，我想是这样的。

sentences.en: It's really cool.
sentences.zh: 这真的很酷。

sentences.en: And we learned some English.
sentences.zh: 而且我们学到了一些英语。

sentences.en: And we learned some English.
sentences.zh: 而且我们学到了一些英语。

sentences.en: We learned some real plunkerisMs.
sentences.zh: 我们学到了一些真正的“挚爱风”用语。

sentences.en: Well, to all you plunkers out there, thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所有的听众朋友们，感谢你们加入我们。

sentences.en: We loved being with you, and we'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们很享受和你们在一起的时光，我们下次再见。
